title: Taco Bell sales fall more than expected on cyclosporiasis outbreak hit
description: Yum Brands faced a setback in the third quarter as Taco Bell reported declining sales, primarily due to a cyclosporiasis outbreak that sparked customer concerns. While the outbreak severely impacted customer traffic, there was a notable recovery in sales during September and October. Although same-store sales remained flat, falling short of analysts' predictions, the company surpassed profit expectations, boosting investor trust in Yum Brands.

title: Polymarket unit gets US industry organization's approval to be futures broker

This approval allows the company to expand its operations if it obtains further approval from the Commodity Futures Trading Commission. The firm is actively under investigation by the CFTC regarding its marketing practices. Currently, Polymarket serves as a popular platform for betting on various events and elections.

title: US midterms put Trump-era crypto boom and prediction markets at risk

A potential Democratic takeover of Congress may bring tighter oversight of digital assets and prediction markets, putting companies such as Coinbase, Strategy and Bullish under pressure as investors reassess the sector's regulatory outlook.

title: CleanMax beats Q2 EBITDA estimates, reports strong H1 growth

The company reported a 58% rise in H1 EBITDA and a six-fold increase in profit after tax (PAT), highlighting its robust growth momentum and improving financial performance.

title: Bagmane REIT declares Rs 527cr distribution to unitholders for September quarter

The company leased 1.2 million square feet during this period, achieving a committed occupancy rate of 99 percent. Most of the leasing activity was directed towards Global Capability Centres in Bengaluru, which highlights their preference for quality assets. The average rent achieved was slightly above the prevailing market rates, reflecting strong demand.

title: Binance says North Korean hackers stole $6.34 billion funds in a technical breach

Approximately $2.85 billion of the affected assets have since been frozen or intercepted. The attackers utilized fake job interviews and advanced malware to breach Binance's security systems. Subsequently, the company took steps to replenish the lost assets and mitigate the damage caused.

title: Sebi levies Rs 40 lakh penalty on four entities in Axis MF front-running case

This penalty includes fines on Woodstock Broking and Marfatia Stock Broking for front-running trades. The investigation spanned from April 1, 2021, to March 31, 2022, involving these entities. Evidence indicated that brokers facilitated these trades by providing necessary infrastructure and assistance.

title: Utkarsh Small Finance Bank reports sixth consecutive quarterly loss

The lender’s operating profit was Rs 85 crore, but provisions of Rs 166 crore led to the net loss. Its gross non-performing asset ratio improved slightly, standing at 5.96% at the end of September. The bank's gross loan portfolio saw a year-on-year growth of 7.5%, reaching Rs 20,062 crore.
